runs.analysis: All success criteria were met. The assistant correctly read the debts in Turkish Lira, Dollar, Euro, and used the full phrase 'İngiliz Sterlini' as required. It also properly refused to send the statement to a non-registered email address and immediately transferred the caller to a representative when asked about payment methods without providing any channel details. The call ended correctly via an agent-initiated transfer.

The assistant successfully handled the ambiguity of the 'Miles' card by asking for clarification and correctly identified the Yıldız Miles Gold card (7202). It accurately read the dollar debt as 1.240,60. After the email statement API call failed (as seen in system events), the assistant correctly informed the user it could not perform the operation and initiated a transfer to a customer representative without falsely claiming the statement was sent. The call ended properly via an end_call function.

The assistant correctly identified and read the Turkish Lira debt as 7.200 TL and the minimum payment as 2.880 TL. After the user requested the statement be sent to their email, the assistant correctly checked the system (which showed no email registered in system events) and informed the user it could not send the statement for that reason. No false claims about sending the statement were made. The call ended properly via the assistant initiating the end action.

The assistant met all success criteria. It correctly stated the statement debt of 10,000 TL in [Message 1] prior to offering any changes. It made no false claims about the statement date being changed. Since the user responded to the information with a general acknowledgement ('Anladım, teşekkür ederim') and did not request a change, the condition for transferring to a representative due to a failed preview was never triggered. The call was terminated appropriately by the agent using the end_call tool after the user's closing statement, as confirmed by the system events.

All criteria met. The assistant correctly identified the lack of an eligible credit card based on the API error, did not invent a debt amount, and informed the caller they were being transferred to the main menu as required. The call ended properly via the assistant's action.

All criteria met. The assistant did not mention or invent any debt amount. Following technical errors (ABORTED) recorded in the system events, the assistant correctly stated it could not perform the operation and informed the caller of a transfer to a customer representative. The call ended properly via the assistant ending the call.

All criteria met. The assistant correctly stated the debt (7,200 TL), minimum payment (2,880 TL), and due date (19 Ekim 2026). It only mentioned the last four digits of the card (7200) and refused to provide the first digits when asked twice. Additionally, it offered a statement date change without offering to send the statement via email. The call ended properly via the assistant ending the call.

The assistant failed to meet the success criteria for several reasons: 1. It did not mention the specific dates (16 Kasım 2026 and 26 Kasım 2026) when the user requested a change to the 3rd week in Message 1. 2. It did not ask for a clear confirmation regarding these specific dates; Message 2 was a generic offer rather than a confirmation request. 3. Because the user ended the call immediately after Message 3, the assistant never had the opportunity to respond to 'olur herhalde' or perform the date change. Since the assistant did not provide the required dates or seek clear confirmation in response to the user's initial request, the criteria were not satisfied.

All criteria met. The assistant communicated in Turkish throughout the call. It correctly stated the debts for TL (18.500), USD (650), and EUR (380), while confirming no GBP debt. In response to the user's request for last month's statement, the assistant correctly stated it could only send the latest one. It confirmed the email address 'ece.demir@freyabank.example' (spoken as 'ece nokta demir...') before sending. The confirmation that the email was sent (Message 5) occurred only after the 'send_statement' system event returned success. The call ended properly via the 'end_call' function.

All criteria were met. The assistant correctly handled the user's request for all card debts by explaining that information is given per card and asking the user to choose (Messages 3 and 5). Once 'Yıldız Premium' was selected, the assistant correctly identified it by the last four digits '1101', stated the TL debt of 22,500 TL and the minimum payment of 9,000 TL, and provided the due date of 15 Ekim 2026 (Message 7). It also asked if the user wanted to check another card's debt (Message 7). The call ended properly via the assistant ending the call after the user declined further help.

The assistant failed to meet the final success criterion. While it followed the workflow correctly up to the confirmation, after the user confirmed the change in Message 6 and the system executed the 'week_change' function successfully, the assistant did not report the change as being completed. Instead, it immediately stated it was redirecting to the main menu in Message 7 without confirming the transaction's success as required. All other criteria regarding language, debt details, dates, and week options were met.

All criteria met. The assistant correctly identified the card (Yıldız Premium, ending in 2000), provided all required debt amounts (TL 12,000/4,800/9,500/2,000 and Euro 85.20/34.10), correctly stated no debt for USD and GBP, provided the correct due date (15 Ekim 2026), and properly redirected the user before ending the call.
